title: Heartbeat Monitor
description: Real-time boss heartbeat monitoring. Auto-refreshes every 30s. Use this dashboard as your primary ops view to quickly identify which bosses are down or degraded.

panels.title: Heartbeat Status Matrix
panels.description: Last heartbeat per boss with severity: CRITICAL (>300s), WARNING (120-300s), OK (<120s). Sorted by severity descending.

targets.query:
SELECT
  boss_id,
  cluster,
  timestamp AS last_heartbeat,
  dateDiff('second', timestamp, now()) AS lag_seconds,
  docker_running,
  docker_total,
  disk_used_pct,
  multiIf(
    lag_seconds > 300, 'CRITICAL',
    lag_seconds > 120, 'WARNING',
    'OK'
  ) AS alert_level
FROM boss_heartbeats
WHERE (boss_id, timestamp) IN (
  SELECT boss_id, max(timestamp)
  FROM boss_heartbeats
  GROUP BY boss_id
)
ORDER BY alert_level, lag_seconds DESC

panels.title: Boss Uptime Timeline
panels.description: Heartbeat events in the last 30 minutes. Gaps indicate a boss stopped reporting.

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  boss_id,
  1 AS heartbeat
FROM boss_heartbeats
WHERE timestamp > now() - 1800
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Recent Heartbeat Count
panels.description: Total heartbeats received in the last 5 minutes

targets.query: SELECT count() FROM boss_heartbeats WHERE timestamp > now() - 300

panels.title: Bosses with Stale Heartbeat
panels.description: Bosses that have not heartbeated in the last 2 minutes

targets.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT boss_id) FROM boss_heartbeats WHERE timestamp < now() - 120
SELECT count(DISTINCT boss_id) FROM boss_heartbeats WHERE disk_used_pct > 85 AND timestamp > now() - 300
